Following up on our MSA + Order Form (attached v3) before signature. Legal needs two things confirmed so we can schedule signature and COI issuance:

1) Insurer point-of-contact for Certificate of Insurance and endorsement issuance (name/email + direct phone). We need the underwriter or liaison who will accept the Additional Insured wording in Section 7 of the Order Form.

I've attached the current Order Form and our COI sample for the insurer to reference.

Thanks for the ping. I'm the underwriter covering this file at Northshore. Quick answers:

• We can issue the standard Additional Insured endorsement (CG 2026 series equivalent) to name the two Redwood entities once we have the signed Order Form and the exact legal entity strings. Please provide:
  - Redwood Inference, Inc. (parent)
  - Redwood Inference — Product Services LLC (example; confirm exact wording on the Order Form)

• Retro date: we will accept a retroactive date of 2026-05-01 provided no material changes occur between that date and the policy issue date. I need the signed order and a short note from your procurement confirming no outstanding operational changes.

• Limits and endorsements: primary policy limits meet your Order Form minimums; endorsement language attached (see endorsement-sample.pdf). If you need alternate wording, send markup and we can review.

Timing: once Tony provides the signed Order Form and entity strings, we can issue a binder/COI within 48 hours. Endorsement issuance is typically 48–72 hours after binder if no premium adjustment is needed. If a premium is required, we will advise immediately.

I'll accept emailed confirmation to sara.patel@northshoreins.com and will queue issuance upon receipt.
